messages:
Leah (Hiring Manager): Heads up 1 new Product Manager Sam starts Mon 9:30am PT. Can someone drop a compact manager-facing checklist + a short 30/60/90 I can paste into the welcome email?
Maya (People Ops): On it. I'll keep it bite-sized so managers can forward directly. Any manager commitments you want highlighted?
Leah (Hiring Manager): Weekly 1:1, set a first-week deliverable, and schedule 30/60/90 checkpoints. Also need a tiny who-to-contact list.
Toby (IT): From IT: confirm laptop (mac/linux) and if they need AWS console access. We image machines 48-72h before start. If invites fail, open ticket at @it and attach the invite error.
Erin (Buddy): I'll be buddy. I can run a 30m team intro and a 45m environment walkthrough on Day 1. Will post a short intro in #product.
Maya (People Ops): COPY/PASTE MANAGER ONE-PAGER (single paragraph + bullets for email)
- Pre-boarding: Confirm laptop choice, shipping address, and personal email for calendar invites. Add to Slack channels (#product, #eng-all, #announcements).
- Day 1: 9:30 welcome w/manager (15m), team intros (30m), IT checklist (15m), lunch with buddy. PM should get a small orientation task (write 1-page problem statement).
- Week 1: Product context, customer calls, analytics access, and shadowing sessions.
- By day 14: Draft 30/60/90 and review with manager.
- Ongoing: Schedule weekly 1:1 for first 12 weeks, 30/60/90 checkpoint meetings.

Maya (People Ops): WHO TO CONTACT (short list)
- IT: @it 1 laptop and access issues
- Security: @security 1 SSO/MFA and secrets
- Benefits/Payroll: @people-ops 1 forms and payroll questions
- Buddy: @Erin 1 day-to-day and culture

Maya (People Ops): 30/60/90 (short prompts for manager to personalize)
- 30 days: "Has full read access to core repos and analytics, delivered a scoped onboarding task, and met key stakeholders."
- 60 days: "Leads a small feature or experiment, owns metrics for that work, and is improving onboarding docs."
- 90 days: "Delivers measurable product impact that ties to OKRs, runs a planning meeting, and mentors a new joiner."

Toby (IT): Add note: If laptop is delayed, use cloud dev box: https://devbox.redwood.internal (temporary token via @it). Grant staging view by Day 2; deploy rights after manager + security approval.

Erin (Buddy): Team welcome template for #product: "Welcome @Sam! Sam joins as PM on Mon 9:30am PT. Buddy: @Erin. We'll do a quick intro at 10am and grab lunch. Drop any resources you think are helpful here." :tada:

Sam (New hire): Thanks everyone! Quick Q: will I have access to product analytics on Day 1 or need a request?

Toby (IT): You'll usually get view access to analytics by Day 2. If you need it Day 1 for ramp, raise a ticket at @it and cc your manager.

Leah (Hiring Manager): This looks great. Maya, can you paste a one-line offer blurb I can include?

Maya (People Ops): Offer blurb: "Welcome to Redwood! Attached is a brief first-week agenda and a starter 30/60/90. We'll provision your accounts before Day 1; for setup help contact @it. Your buddy @Erin will meet you for lunch on Day 1. Excited to have you!"

Leah (Hiring Manager): Perfect 1 sending now. Thanks team :rocket:
